messages:
auditor_jen: Hi team — auditor asking for evidence bundle to show control mapping for dataflows involving S3, ECS tasks, and KMS usage. They want: (1) CloudTrail events for key usage and kms:Decrypt for service accounts, (2) RBAC change logs for the last 12 months (rolebindings/service-account edits), (3) sample dataflow diagram + signed manifest of exported artifacts. Can we confirm what we can provide and the export path?

elena (security): We can provide all three. For CloudTrail/KMS usage we usually export CloudTrail -> S3 and run Athena queries; also we have a prebuilt extraction script that pulls events and signs the bundle.

auditor_jen: Prefer CSV/JSON outputs and a manifest with hashes. Time window requested: 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31. Also need proof of key rotation for the CMKs used by S3/ECS secrets.

elena (security): Copy. We'll include: list of CMK ARNs, rotation events (CreateKey / ScheduleKeyDeletion / RotateKey where applicable), and the audit trail showing which principal called kms:Decrypt.

benji (infra): For RBAC we'll export k8s audit logs + IAM change events. Example kubectl query we run for rolebinding deltas:

```
# list rolebindings changed in last 90 days (audit log filter)
jq -r '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="patchRoleBinding" or .eventName=="createRoleBinding" or .eventName=="deleteRoleBinding")' cloudtrail-export.json > rbac-changes.json
```

We can also map service accounts to ECS task roles in the same bundle.

dave_ops: Packaging path: s3://redwood-compliance/audits/iso_soc2/2026-03-31/auditor_jen_bundle_v1.zip. We'll upload a signed tar with SHA256 and include the signing cert.

auditor_jen: Can you include obfuscated usernames but preserve principal ARNs and IPs? Also would like correlation IDs for incidents if any overlap with requested window.

elena (security): Yes — we redact PII (human names) but keep ARNs and session IDs. For incident correlation we will include a table of incident IDs + log anchors. Note: some older logs are in Splunk; we'll pull using the export job.

ir-bot: Incident summary for overlap window:
- INC-2025-09-14: brief denial-of-service against inference edge, mitigated; logs retained in splunk: index=infra source=elb | head 100
- INC-2026-01-08: privilege escalation attempt detected, investigators: @elena, @benji

maria (compliance): A few checklist items for the bundle: 1) manifest.json (file list + sha256), 2) redaction report (what fields redacted + why), 3) control crosswalk table (control id -> artifact file), 4) key rotation evidence PDF.

elena (security): Will produce manifest + crosswalk. For Athena/KMS usage the query we run is below — this gives kms:Decrypt calls against CMK IDs used by S3 SSE-CMK and ECS secrets manager:

```
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress
FROM "cloudtrail_logs".cloudtrail
WHERE eventSource = 'kms.amazonaws.com'
  AND (eventName='Decrypt' OR eventName='GenerateDataKey')
  AND eventTime BETWEEN timestamp '2025-04-01' AND timestamp '2026-03-31';
```

We'll attach the CSV of that result and also the raw CloudTrail slice.

auditor_jen: Good. For RBAC change evidence — please include the before/after of rolebinding YAMLs where available. Auditor will validate the change was approved.

benji (infra): We have approval artifacts in linear/ticketing for all org-level RBAC changes; pointer example: https://linear.app/REDWOOD/issue/RW-2345. We'll include exported PDFs of the approvals.

elena (security): Note on key material — we do NOT export plaintext keys. We'll provide key metadata, rotation events, and signed KMS audit extract showing which principal invoked crypto operations. CMK IDs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/a1b2c3d4-KEYEXAMPLE and arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/e5f6g7h8-KEYEX2

auditor_jen: Please confirm chain-of-custody — how will you guarantee the exported bundle hasn't been tampered with after we receive it?

dave_ops: We'll produce bundle.zip, upload to s3 (path above), then create a detached signature using our compliance signing key and publish signature at s3://redwood-compliance/signatures/auditor_jen_bundle_v1.sig and include a SHA256 manifest. We can also provide a one-time pre-signed URL with expiration.

elena (security): One more item — we need to flag any dev/test datasets accidentally included. We'll run a scan script to detect sample PII and exclude. Expected delivery: preliminary bundle for auditor review in 48 hours, final after feedback within 5 business days.

auditor_jen: 48h timeline works. Quick Q: can you include a sample Splunk query and the resulting export for the RBAC change that led to INC-2026-01-08?

elena (security): Yes — Splunk query we used:
```
index=k8s_audit action=update OR action=create source="kube.audit" | search objectRef.resource=rolebinding OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebinding | table _time, user, objectRef.name, requestObject
```
We'll include the raw JSON event for that incident and a short notes.md describing what fields we redacted.

auditor_jen: Thanks, please ping when upload is ready. :thumbsup:

elena (security): Pinged once upload complete and added ticket in linear RW-4982 to track the bundle and auditor feedback.

dave_ops: Upload job started, ETA ~3h. Pre-signed URL will be in the ticket.

auditor_jen: got it, will watch RW-4982.
